turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have about twenty minutes. My son found out he got a zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
Don't thank me. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.
A machine's guess. Procedure 4.3, your own school's, says software alone doesn't establish anything, and the company that sells it says the same. What else do you have, Hale?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.

"Quite reliable." Fourteen detection tools were tested in 2023 and found neither accurate nor reliable, and I have that printed in my bag. If a percentage is all you've got, I'm going upstairs to the principal when we're done here.
So I had to give him a zero.
"Had to." So the zero went in first, and nobody asked Owen or called me until after. That's punishment first and questions later, and I've watched this school do it before.
I hope you understand my position.
Your position is a number from a machine and a zero you entered without a phone call. Withdraw it, Hale.
